answer: Trust propagates on an attestation graph through a bounded random walk: each step follows a validated edge, while a prism of independent attestations filters duplicate identities. A sybil cluster is a vault separated by a sparse cut with conductance φ=|∂S|/vol(S); within t steps, its escape probability is O(tφ), bounding its stationary mass and aggregate voting weight. An honest inlet of cross-cut attestations improves mixing.
